CIE 1072-B                                                                                                            about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 23-May-2023 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS - MAY/JUNE 2023  
  SUBJECT: CIE 1072-CHM/CIE 1052-B/CIE 1072-B - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIE 1072-CHM]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)             How scientists have been able to reconstruct earth's CO2 and average Antarctic  
  temperature history?                                                                   (5)  
  
  1B)             Why Ballari was like a republic unto itself?  
  (5)  
  
  2A)             Explain any five key factors controlling soil formation.  
  (5)  
  
  2B)             Discuss with suitable examples on how international agreements have played a key role  
  in mitigating environmental issues.                                                   (5)  
  
  3A)             Explain with two examples how plastic waste can be utilized in road construction.  
  (5)  
  
  3B)             List down any five legal acts related to air pollution.  
  (5)  
  
  4A)             Discuss the laws governing sustainable use of our water resources.  
  (5)  
  
  4B)             Discuss the use of technology in disaster preparedness.  
  (5)  
  
  5A)             Discuss the role of any one nodal agency in disaster management with brief explanation  
  of their forecasting system.                                                           (5)  
  
  5B)             Explain the structure of functioning of Disaster management authority in India.  
  (5)  
  
  
  -----End-----
